name: Islautopia HTTPS for Home Assistant
description: Real HTTPS for your whole Home Assistant instance, on your own network, with or without internet - no domain, no DNS account, no port forwarding, and nothing outside your house to depend on. OPEN WEB UI below gives a device the certificate that makes that address trusted: once per device, and optional. Own an IG Doorbell? Put its identifier in the configuration and you also get a public hostname every browser already trusts, with nothing to install.

ports_description.8443/tcp: Secure HTTPS access to Home Assistant
ports_description.8099/tcp: Trust portal: downloads the certificate that keeps HTTPS working without internet (optional, plain HTTP by design)
